scope: Independent one-ahead nativeWait worker with serialized consumerBegin/End. Missing1.1ms native-completion headroom becomes exact held presentation phase; preserve producer/GPU-preparer ownership and physical cadence.
headset_validation: Pending fresh MSFS comparison. Mocked downstream XR plus actual GPU resources prove overlap, ownership, held margin and cleanup; they do not prove steady90 in the headset.
native_wait: One worker owns all rawWait calls including the seed. Each next job is posted only after currentBegin succeeds and its head is selected. It requires an actual accepted-input ordinal, allowing sourceGPU preparation to overlap Wait. One active/completed future prediction maximum. NextWait may run while currentEnd sleeps/executes; Begin/End remain exclusively consumer-owned.
native_latency: Forecast no longer clips to1P: observed service bounded2P, forecast bounded2P+1.1ms within existing three-credit default pipeline. After Begin/Release and copy completion, runtime_ready shifts deadline only by max(0,releaseComplete+1.1ms-deadline), retains that exact phase, and adds zero when headroom is already sufficient. The physical End minimum period and2usguard are unchanged; no producer sleep or extra image/credit.
prediction_time: Each packet keeps its own Wait prediction even when a later Wait completes. If existing QPC conversion succeeds and that prediction expired during a long previousEnd, advance its runtime phase by whole physical periods. If conversion is absent/fails, retain the raw prediction; long-stall fallback without that extension is not headset-validated. Projection poses and pixel FIFO are unchanged.
stop_and_errors: Stop closes currentBegin, joins an uncancellable in-flight nativeWait, then balances a completed unusedWait with one Begin/emptyEnd before session end/restart. Pending unentered jobs cancel without a native call. FutureWait errors propagate after current valid content is delivered. Publish Endfailure before returning a producer credit, fixing a race exposed by failure_wakeup.
validation: New GPU tests block nextWait while currentEnd completes on another thread; verify exactpixels, strict period, stop/join/balancing/restart, and futureWait failure. Long-held End explicitly exercises expired prediction phase advancement. Deterministic schedule checks require exactly1ms added at a missing margin and no repeated charge. Existing5msWait+8msGPUprep overlap, boundedFIFO/backpressure, updatedoverlay, real-index alias, static restart, allroutes,UI/INI pass.
